zh.title: 把计算费用算进去，并行审查还值得吗？
zh.summary: 对一份合成文档审查研究的汇总值进行成本敏感性计算，展示计算费用如何改变方案选择，以及舍入精度如何限制架构排名。

en.title: Does Parallel Review Still Pay Once Compute Counts?
en.summary: A cost sensitivity calculation on reported synthetic-document review rates shows how resource charges change choices and how rounding limits architecture rankings.
